selectionPolicy.rationale: Six previously published paper WIN candidates retained for audit. None has the complete structured, independently sourced and timestamped WIN qualification required by the new public confidence gate. Four separate each-way research candidates remain published. No number of selections is forced.
selectionPolicy.winQualificationRule: Evidence-led pre-publication confirmation of ability/class, recent form, course/going/trip and rivals, supported by verified fitness and connections. Betting odds, favourite status, market rank and existing qualitative STRONG badges are not inputs. Unreviewed WIN candidates stay out of the featured category; historical paper bets remain immutable.

midshotsPolicy.publicNote: Course/trip and trainer-entry hypotheses, field shape and value-first E/W; place claims are not calibrated.
midshotsPolicy.priceRule: £5 each-way per paper single. Only quoted early prices 6/1 and above; no invented longshots. Under the paper ledger 8+ runners pays top 3 at 1/4 odds.
